terms.comment: In Macrobius and Martianus Capella the Greek name of the Milky Way, “called in pure Latin via lactea” (Lewis & Short); the sense “a galaxy”, one of many, is modern (Egger, in Morgan–Owens). Our own galaxy is the orbis lacteus (see the Milky Way).

phrases.latin: Sōl noster ūna est ex innumerābilibus stēllīs galaxiae nostrae.
phrases.english: Our sun is one of the countless stars in our galaxy.

phrases.latin: Orbis lacteus nōn ūnus est: galaxiae sunt innumerābilēs.
phrases.english: The Milky Way isn’t the only one: there are countless galaxies.

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. galaxy; s.v. galaxy: Milky Way.
